items.title: Is D-Wave Quantum’s (QBTS) AT&T Win Quietly Redefining Its Competitive Edge In Enterprise Computing?

AT&T reported cutting a key network optimization workload from about one hour to less than 15 seconds using D-Wave’s annealing-based system, underscoring the technology’s operational impact.
